name: Entropy Loss for Floater Cleaning
definition: An entropy loss regularization to encourage Gaussian opacities to be either 0 or 1, allowing floaters to be automatically removed during training via a pruning mechanism pipeline.
summary: Entropy loss is a regularization technique that forces Gaussian opacities to binary values to automatically remove floaters, distinguishing itself by operating directly on opacity parameters rather than using sparsity-based masking.
